_comment: Copy to tools/packs.json and list your world's server-streamed packs. Every folder in roots is excluded from the web main pck and built by tools/build_packs_cli.gd into server/assets/pck/<name>.pck. required packs gate play until downloaded; priority orders the rest (lower first). With entries, only the transitive dependencies of those files (within the roots) are packed; without entries the whole folder ships. on_demand packs are fetched only when asked for (a player's own character). region (an id from regions.json) holds a pack until the player enters that region; the home region is entered at connect.
